max_tokens.detail: Built and protected by the agent adapter; native JSON accepts caller input.

messages.detail: Runtime-owned history, source and title; native document context/cache/citations decorations are supported. Five pinned citation variants have typed output and private replay with offline fixtures. Custom-content documents, search-result inputs and live behavior remain unverified.

system.detail: Built and protected by the agent adapter; native JSON accepts caller input.

tools.detail: Runtime application tools and provider-model hostedTools are built and protected by the adapter. Selected pinned hosted blocks, approvals and paused continuation have offline fixtures; full nested semantics and live behavior remain unverified.

model.detail: Adapter model constructor and SDK configure; native JSON accepts caller input.

output_config.detail: SDK configure; runtime output schema is protected when requested. Native JSON accepts caller input.

stream.detail: Agent uses SDK streaming; native client controls the request mode.

user_profile_id.detail: The adapter exposes a userProfileId header; native JSON accepts this body field separately.

cache_control.detail: Dart SDK 9.0.1 request configure; native JSON also accepts this field. Nested agent semantics are not established.

container.detail: Initial configuration uses SDK/native JSON. Returned container IDs from message-start/delta are retained privately and reused across paused and local-tool continuations; inherited IDs are protected. Live expiry and files are unverified.
